question: Should OpenClaw accept this read-only artifact/provenance preview shape as the next Claws core plan contract while the base Claws PRs are still open drafts?
rationale: Automation can check parser reuse and read-only behavior, but it cannot choose durable selector, install-surface, provenance, and trust semantics for future install behavior.

options.title: Gate On Contract Approval
options.body: Keep this PR open until a maintainer explicitly approves the base Claws stack plus artifact, selector, install-surface, and provenance semantics.

options.title: Accept The Preview Contract
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge this preview as the compatibility baseline for future Claw install and provenance work.

options.title: Revise Before Merge
options.body: Change selector support, install-surface names, or provenance record families before plan output becomes depended on.

recommendation.title: Gate On Contract Approval
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until a maintainer explicitly approves the base Claws stack plus artifact, selector, install-surface, and provenance semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a new core Claws lifecycle contract and steipete is the listed project lead with recent nearby parser-surface history.
